summary.text: Chris Tanner is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 54 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Ken Corbet.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Kansan, a 30-year Topeka resident, a former pastor and a former Kansas Historical Society employee, and listed lower property taxes, affordable health care and public schools among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Chris Tanner earned a high school diploma from Mountain View High School and a bachelor's degree from Messenger College, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a property manager.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for District 54 on August 4, 2026, receiving 1,392 votes in a race with no other Democratic candidate.
In his Ballotpedia survey responses, Tanner said his campaign centers on lowering property taxes, strengthening small businesses and creating better jobs.
He said he supports fully funding public education and investing in workforce and technical training programs.
He also said he supports expanding access to affordable health care, including Medicaid expansion, and fair wages and workers' rights.
